description: This file contains helper utility functions for UUID generation, datetime formatting, pagination handling, input sanitization, permission checking, and activity logging within a backend system. It serves as a utility module to support the backend application functions.

methods.name: Optional[str] format_datetime(dt: Optional[datetime])
methods.description: Format datetime to ISO string, or return None if input is None.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] create_pagination_params(page: int = 1, per_page: int = 20)
methods.description: Create pagination parameters with default page size and enforce valid limits.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_paginated_response( items: List[Dict[str, Any]], total: int, page: int, per_page: int )
methods.description: Construct a paginated response dict with items, total, page info, and navigation flags.

methods.name: Optional[str] sanitize_input(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Sanitize user input text by trimming and limiting length.

methods.name: bool check_user_permission( user_id: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: str, db )
methods.description: Asynchronously check if a user has permission to access a specified resource, based on resource type.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_activity_log( user_id: str, action: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: str, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None )
methods.description: Create an activity log dictionary with user action and resource details, timestamped.
